entity: Labadie plant and the top-10 coal plants' share of monitored SO2, 2025
what_we_add: Ten plants at 30% of all monitored SO2 (217,766 of 715,725 tons), Labadie 38,232; 7 of 10 with no retirement year filed
why: The Post-Dispatch headline has Labadie as the top SO2 emitter in the US and Reuters says Ameren didn't contest the EPA-data analysis; Nebraska Public Media had it second in 2020. The ten-plant concentration and retirement-date gap are ours.
